Salamander Grand Piano (V3), 14 notes: A, C, D#, F# in each octave from A2 to A5, plus C6.

Recorded by Alexander Holm. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Original: https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3
These mp3 copies are the ones the Tone.js project hosts at https://tonejs.github.io/audio/salamander/
(downloaded 2026-11-24, unchanged).

Used only by the teacher console's live game "Higher or lower?" (live-hilo.js), which plays two notes
on the room speakers. A note between two recordings is made by playing the nearest one faster or slower
(never more than a semitone and a half off). Students' Chromebooks never load these files.
